{T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\Vanity_Items_1:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

Customize your Appearance with Vanity Items!


Cosmetic Vanity items help you create your unique look tailored to your class fantasy.

You can find a huge selection on the Auction House! Click the Rarity Dropdown and select Vanity. Then hit Search!

You can Ctrl + Left Click an item to preview its appearance. Find and Buyout any Vanity item on the Auction House.

Max level builds are significantly more powerful than leveling builds. It's vital that you upgrade your build at max level to succeed in end-game content.

• You can find many end-game ready builds in the Hero Architect. Hit N, then click the Hero Architect Tab, then select either Level 60 or 70 Builds depending on your current level.

{T:Interface\Tutorials\PathToAscension\endgamebuilds1:2:1}

You can scroll through high-rated end game builds to find one that matches your playstyle!

End-game builds rely on Mystic Enchants. Each build will show the required Mystic Enchants at the bottom of the build page.

{T:Interface\Tutorials\PathToAscension\endgamebuilds2:2:1}

You should acquire the Legendary and Epic enchants suggested immediately to unlock the full power of the build, then seek out the Blue and Green enchants as soon as possible.

• It is highly recommended you try out featured builds before trying to create your own end-game build. You can also reference high-rated builds when creating your own to start with a strong foundation.

Once you choose a build and begin to grow comfortable with it, don't be afraid to experiment and adjust the build to your specific style of play.

{T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\10_1:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

Item Level Shows Your Gear Power!!


The first step to improving your power at end-game is to improve your gear. It's time to start replacing your leveling gear with max level gear!

Mouse over any piece of gear to see the item level. This is a good general measurement of gear's power.

You can view your Average Item Level in your character sheet. This is an approximation of how strong your gear is!

{page} {T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\10_2:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

Upgrade Gear - Increase Your Item Level!


There are many paths to upgrading your gear:
•Complete Dungeons
•Quest in Max Level Zones
•Enter the Manastorm
•Complete Call Board Daily Quests

{T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\11_1:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

Extract 3 Epic Enchants to your Enchant Collection


Epic Mystic Enchants can be found by Reforging, the Auction House, and exploring the world. Epic Enchants offer huge leaps in power!

Try to collect 3 Epic Enchants that directly empower your current spells or Archetype.

If you run out of Mystic Extracts you can Reforge until you get more!

{T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\12_1:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

Extract a Legendary Enchant to your Enchant Collection


Legendary Mystic Enchants can be found by Reforging, the Auction House, and exploring the world. Legendary Enchants offer build defining power and entirely new ways to play!

Try to collect a Legendary Enchant that directly empower your most used spells or Archetype.

If you run out of Mystic Extracts you can Reforge until you get more!

{T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\Dungeon_Finder_2:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

Complete a Dungeon!


Open the Dungeon Finder and queue for a Random Normal Dungeon or pick any of the available Specific Dungeons.

Normal Difficulty Dungeons are entry level end-game content that will help you learn your build and gear up!

{T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\heroicdungeons1:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

Complete a Heroic Dungeon!


Open the Dungeon Finder and queue for a Random Heroic Dungeon or pick any of the available Heroic Dungeons under Specific Dungeons.

You are ready to queue for Heroic Dungeons! These are more challenging than Normal Dungeons and offer higher item level gear rewards!

{T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\18_1:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

Heroic Raiding - Heroic Loot!


Heroic Raids drop Heroic Raid Gear! This is the same loot that drops from Normal Raids, but stronger!

Heroic Raids build on everything you learned in Normal Raids. Boss mechanics deal more damage, and ignoring them will almost always lead to death!

It's helpful to have maxed PvE Power and Mystic Enchants that compliment your build.

{T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\arenaqueue1:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

You Can Queue for 2v2 Arenas Solo!


You can join a 2v2 Arena Game without a partner. Qeuue solo, and you will be matched with another player for a 2v2 match!

To join any 2v2 game, open the PvP interface (Hotkey H) and click the arena drop-down tab.

Select 2v2 rated arena battle, then "Join Battle" to solo-queue.

{T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\Mystic_Enchant_Collection_1:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

Save 10 Mystic Enchants to your Enchant Collection!


Remember you can only have 1 Legendary Enchant and 3 Epic Enchants active at a time! You can't only collect Legendary and Epics!

Try to collect Rare and Uncommon Mystic Enchants that also empower your current spells or Archetype.

Rare and Uncommons usually stack up to 3 times. This will allow you to start filling all 17 Active Enchant Slots to maximize your power!

{T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\Epic_Riding_2:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

Ride at 100% Mounted Movement Speed!


Talk to a Riding Trainer to learn Journeyman Riding! This will increase your mounted movement speed from 60% to 100%!

Visit your Capital City and ask a guard for directions to the Riding Trainer.

You can often acquire a |cffe6cc80|Hitem:3001005|h[Riding Tome: Journeyman Riding]|h|r from the Auction House or another player cheaper than the Trainer offers!

{T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\Bazaar_Tokens_1:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

Buy a Bazaar Token from the Auction House!


Bazaar Tokens have many uses and can be traded!Bazaar Tokens can be spent at Tiraxis on Cosmetics and Convenience items, or used to complete missed Call Board Daily Quests.

Visit the Auction House and purchase a Bazaar Token!

{T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\Titan_Scrolls_1:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

Buff the whole realm!


Titan Scrolls grant a unique buff to every hero in the open world based on the titan they resemble. Multiple scrolls can be used to stack each buff to 5 and refresh their duration.

Titan Scrolls announce who used them in Global Chat, letting other heroes know who to thank!

{page} {T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\Titan_Scrolls_2:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

There are 5 difference Titan Scrolls:
• Norgannon
• Eonar
• Aggramar
• Khaz'goroth
• Golganneth

You can obtain them from the Auction House or randomly when slaying creatures.

{T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\39_1:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

Activate a Mystic Enchant from Your Collection!


You can activate Mystic Enchants saved to your Enchant Collection at the Altar!

Open an Enchanting Altar and click select Enchant Collection tab.

Then select a Mystic Enchant from your Collection, apply it to an Active Enchant Slot, then click Save Changes.

{page} {T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\39_2:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

Activating Mystic Enchants Requires Mystic Orbs!


Collected enchants can be activated an unlimited number of times across all of your characters.

Each activation requires Mystic Orbs. If you run out of Orbs then gold will be consumed instead.

Mystic Orbs are found in almost all content. Call Board Daily Quests and completing Paths to Ascension is a great way to earn Orbs!

{page} {T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\39_3:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

Always Active! You Can Replace or Remove Enchants!


Activated Mystic Enchants Are Always Active! You can apply a new Mystic Enchant on top of an active one to overwrite it!

Right-click an active Mystic Enchant to remove it. Removed enchants will still be in your collection! This can be done without an Altar.

{T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\50_1:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

Choose Your Path to Unlock Stat Bonuses!


There are five Paths to choose from:
• Strength - Heavy hits and Armor Penetration.
• Agility - Rapid hits and Critical Strikes.
• Intellect - Increased Mana pool and Spell Power.
• Duality - Hybrid combat. Empowers both physical and magic damage simultaneously.
• Healing - Heal and support allies as a dedicated Healer.


Your Path can be changed for free at any time in Character Advancement (Hotkey N).

{T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\collectionsandcapitals2:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

You have a new item in your Vanity Collection!

A Scroll of Retreat will be added to your Vanity Collection AT LEVEL 20 that will teleport you to your Capital City! You can deliver any Vanity Item to complete this quest.

Your Vanity Collection is shared to all characters on this realm.

Convenience items like the Book of Ascension, Cosmetics, Pets, Mounts, Heirlooms and more are stored here and accessible by all of your characters.

{page} {T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\collectionsandcapitals1:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

Claim your Scroll of Retreat!

Deliver your Scroll of Retreat so you can teleport to your Capital City!
•Open Character Advancement.
•Click the Vanity Tab.
•Type Scroll of Retreat into the search bar or Filter by Known.
•Find and click the scroll, and then Deliver Item.

Your Scroll of Retreat will be sent directly to your bags! Vanity items are either sent directly to your bags or to the Ascension Vanity Items tab in your Spell Book.

{T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\Capital_of_the_Horde_1:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

Fast Travel to Orgrimmar with your Scroll of Retreat!


Orgrimmar is the capital city for the Horde and offers important services:

• Bank and Auction House
• Call Board
• Class Trainers, Profession Trainers, and Riding Trainers
• Flightmasters
• Vendors and more!

{page} {T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\57_2:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

Navigating Through the City


Opening your Map inside the city will show POIs for important services and NPCs. Mouse over these icons to see their function.

The city may be large, but Orgrimmar Grunts can give you directions on where you need to go!

{page} {T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\57_3:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

Report to High Warlord Saurfang


Heroes travel from the furthest reaches of Azeroth to seek comfort and companionship behind the mighty walls surrounding the city. The time has come for you to do the same, Hero.

Travel to the great warrior city of Orgrimmar and announce yourself to High Warlord Saurfang. He will be waiting to greet you inside the walls.

{T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\58_1:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

Fast Travel to Stormwind with your Scroll of Retreat!


Stormwind is the capital city for the Alliance and offers important services:

• Bank and Auction House
• Call Board
• Class Trainers, Profession Trainers, and Riding Trainers
• Flightmasters
• Vendors and more!

{page} {T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\58_2:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

Navigating Through the City


Opening your Map inside the city will show POIs for important services and NPCs. Mouse over these icons to see their function.

The city may be large, but Stormwind Guards can give you directions on where you need to go!

{page} {T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\58_3:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

Report to Justine Demalier


Heroes travel from the furthest reaches of Azeroth to seek comfort and companionship behind the mighty walls surrounding the city. The time has come for you to do the same, Hero.

Travel to the royal city of Stormwind and announce yourself to Justine Demalier. She will be waiting to greet you inside the walls.

{T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\Fully_Mystic_Enchanted:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

Become Fully Mystic Enchanted!


Mystic Enchants add significant power to your build. Being fully enchanted will determine your success in end-game content.

Apply Mystic Enchants in all 17 Active Enchant Slots. Try to activate enchants that empower your current spells or Archetype!

{T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\64_1:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

Visit the Mark of Triumph Vendor!


Marks of Triumph are earned by completing Heroic and Mythic difficulty dungeons.

These marks can be exchanged for gear! Use them to upgrade your gear or save up for specific equipment key to your build.

Visit Markus in the Stormwind Throne Room to see the gear you can acquire.

{T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\65_1:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

Visit the Mark of Triumph Vendor!


Marks of Triumph are earned by completing Heroic and Mythic difficulty dungeons.

These marks can be exchanged for gear! Use them to upgrade your gear or save up for specific equipment key to your build.

Visit Mar'toge in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom throne room to see the gear you can acquire.

{T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\Mystic_Enchant_Collection_1:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

Save 10 Mystic Enchants to your Enchant Collection!


Collect Rare and Uncommon Mystic Enchants that also empower your current spells or Archetype.

Rare and Uncommons usually stack up to 3 times. This will allow you to start filling all 17 Active Enchant Slots to maximize your power!

Hit N, or click the scroll icon by your mini map to open up the Character Advancement Menu.

Click the Hero Architect tab near the bottom left of the menu.

Scroll through the various builds in the list to the right to find one that interests you or fits your class fantasy. You can change your build anytime, so have fun and pick something that stands out to you. If the build does not match your playstyle you can always repick.

Find a build you would like to play and select "Choose This Build" to activate it. You will immediately learn all the required spells and talents, and will automatically learn spells and talents as you level!

If you are experienced with Ascension, or would like to craft your build from scratch, you can select "No, I'd like to pick abilities and talents myself."

{T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\78_1:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

Craft and Gather Useful Items with Professions!

Professions help you level! Using your profession grants experience while also providing gear, consumables, and materials. You can start by learning two primary professions, and all the secondary ones!

•Primary Gathering Professions: Gatherers can pick up crafting materials around the world. They can sell them for gold, or use the items in their crafting professions.

•Primary Crafting Professions: Crafters can make equipment and other useful items from materials found by gathering professions.

•Secondary Professions: These life skills can be used by anyone without restriction!

{page} {T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\78_2:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

Learn a Profession!


Visit a Beginner’s Book of Artisans to learn your first Profession. Find one using the Map Lens! You can unlearn a profession at any time to learn a new one.

Try to pick two primary professions that work well together like Skinning and Leatherworking, or Herbalism and Alchemy! This way you can gather your own materials to skill up without having to rely on other players.

{page} {T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\78_3:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

Skill Up Your Profession!

You can level up your profession just by using it! Use the Skills Tab (Hotkey K) to view your current, and skill level. Visit a Profession Trainer to increase your maximum skill as you progress.

Difficulty colors guide you on what to do next to skill up. Always try to aim for orange level skills!

•Orange: Always grants a skill point!
•Yellow: Usually grants a skill point.
•Green: Rarely grants a skill point.
•Grey: Does not increase your skill.
•Red: Your skill level isn’t high enough yet!

{page} {T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\78_4:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

Increase Your Skills to Unlock New Recipes

As you craft and gather using your professions, you’ll rank up!

New recipes become available as you gain skill and you can train them at Profession Trainers or the Book of Artisans. Other recipes can be found throughout the world as loot or purchased from vendors and the auction house.

If you want to learn more than two Primary Professions, use a Craftsman’s Codex to gain an additional primary profession slot! You can buy them from Nozdormu, the Auction House, or the webstore.

{T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\79_1:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

You can find a Call Board in any Capital City!

You can use these boards while leveling to discover where to go next and accept any tutorial quests you may have missed.

At max level, the Call Board offers Daily Quests and Weekly Quests granting you Call Board Caches, Marks of Ascension, Mystic Orbs, and Mystic Runes.

{T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\81_1:2:1}

You can find a Call Board in any Capital City!

You can use these boards while leveling to discover where to go next and accept any tutorial quests you may have missed.

At max level, the Call Board offers Daily Quests and Weekly Quests granting you Call Board Caches, Marks of Ascension, Mystic Orbs, and Mystic Runes.

{T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\89_1:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

Join the Dungeon Queue!


The Dungeon Finder automatically pairs you with other heroes in a Party and teleports you to a Dungeon to fight a series of enemies and get awesome loot!

Open the Dungeon Finder (Hotkey “i”, for Instances) or click the Green Eye in your menu bar.

{page} {T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\89_2:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

Select your Role!


Pick your role from the icons at the top. You can only queue as a single role at a time.

•The Shield Icon is for a Tank.
•The Green Health Icon is for a Healer.
•The Sword is for a DPS.

Select Find Group after picking a role that suits your build and spells!

{page} {T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\89_3:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

Continue playing while the party fills up!


You can continue questing, slaying creatures or explore while you wait for your party to fill up. You will be returned to your original location after the dungeon!

The dungeon finder icon will appear on your minimap when you are in the queue. Hover over this icon to see the status and estimated wait time.

When the group fills up, you will see a pop-up notification and be teleported to the dungeon when everyone accepts.

{T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\90_1:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

Increase your Mounted Speed!


Talk to a Riding Trainer to learn Apprentice Riding! This will increase your mounted movement speed from 40% to 60%!

You can find Traveling Riding Trainers in early level quest hubs or visit your Capital City and ask a guard for directions to the Riding Trainer.

{T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\91_1:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

Increase your Mounted Speed!


Talk to a Riding Trainer to learn Apprentice Riding! This will increase your mounted movement speed from 40% to 60%!

You can find Traveling Riding Trainers in early level quest hubs or visit your Capital City and ask a guard for directions to the Riding Trainer.

{T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\lockingspellsandtalents1:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

Locks Protect Your Build and Make Rerolling Easier!


Select the Lock icon on an ability or talent you would like to lock. These can be unlocked at any time.

Locked Spells and Talents cannot be rerolled until unlocking them by clicking the Lock icon again. This prevents accidentally rerolling important spells!

Locked Spells and Talents sort to the top. This allows you to quickly find unlocked spells and talents to reroll and ensures you don't reroll ones you want to keep!

{T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\101_1:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

Reach Level 60!


Continue traveling to new zones to find new quests and more challenging creatures to continue gaining experience.

Check the Path to Ascension menu often for new quests as you level up! Completing Paths to Ascension will grant you rewards as well as ensure you reach the heights of your power while exploring the world and gaining levels!

{T:Interface\Tutorials\PathToAscension\Level70:2:1}

Continue your journey in Outlands and acquire enough experience to reach level 70.

As you continue advancing in levels you will have to travel to new zones to find quests and creatures closer to your level to continue gaining experience.

Hit M, then right click the map. This will zoom you out to the overall World Map. Mouseover the areas around your current zone. You will see the zone's level range in the top center of the map.

Find a zone that matches your level and travel there to discover new quests and continue your journey to level 70.

Resurrect in a safe spot!


When your character dies, a small menu will appear on your screen. You’ll have the option to view the Death Recap to see what caused your death or check the Combat Log in your chat window for a more detailed breakdown.

To continue, click 'Release Spirit' to become a ghost, where you can begin the process of reviving your character.

{page} {T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\193_1:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

In the Spirit World, there are several ways to revive!

Player Resurrection: Nearby players can cast resurrection spells (Revive, Redemption, Rebirth) allowing you to revive at their location.

Return to Corpse: As a ghost, run back to your body and click the prompt to revive. Click 'Return to Graveyard' if you get lost to restart at the spirit healer.

Safe Zone Resurrection: Choose 'Resurrect in a Safe Zone' to instantly revive in the nearest town or Capital City without any penalty.

Spirit Healer: Talk to the spirit healer at the graveyard to revive on the spot. This causes Resurrection Sickness (temporary stat reduction) and reduces equipment durability.

Roll Your Build as You Level!


Wildcard Heroes roll their build! As you level up you will begin rolling random Abilities and Talents starting at level 10!

Wildcard will often grant you Abilities and Talents that synergize with your current build. New ways to play will unfold as you level!

Path to Ascension will walk you through how to further improve your Wildcard build and reroll Abilities and Talents.

{page}{T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\wildcardbasics2:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

Roll New Spells Every 2 Levels!


You will roll your first new spell at level 10, then level 12, 14 and again every 2 levels until max level!

There is no limit to how many Legendary, Epic, Rare or Uncommon spells you can have in your build!

{page}{T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\wildcardbasics3:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

Roll New Talents Every 2 Levels!


You will roll your first new Talent at level 11, then level 13, 15 and again every other level until max level!

There is no limit to how many Legendary, Epic, Rare or Uncommon Talents you can have in your build!

Multi-rank talents that would normally require 5 Talent Essence still only count as a single talent essence on Wildcard.

{T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\247_1:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

You Can Save Your Transmogs with Outfits!


Once you’ve made a complete transmog, you can save it with the Outfits tab in the Wardrobe! This way if you change your look, you can apply your previously saved Outfit with ease and not have to remake your transmog from scratch.

You can have as many different Outfits as you like, there is no limit!

Your Outfit collection is saved to your server, so all of your different characters can apply your various transmogs with just the click of a button!

Mystic Enchant Quality


Mystic Enchants are separated by quality; Rare, Epic, Legendary, and Artifact. These enchants will enhance spells, change abilities, or improve stats in different ways.

•Rare Enchants - Offers notable ability improvements or stat boosts. You can have active up to 6 Rare enchants at once.

•Epic Enchants - Moderately impoves abilities and stats. Your character is limited to 3 active Epic enchantments.

•Legendary Enchants - Capable of completely transforming spell and ability mechanics. Only one Legendary enchant can be used per specialization.

•Artifact Enchant- Teaches you a new and powerful spell or ability.

{T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\ability_racial_arcaneaffinity:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

Mystic Enchanting: Fully Loaded!


Mystic Enchants are your key to maximizing the potential of your character. You will therefor want to make certain that you've applied all of the enchants that you can from your collection to your active enchants. You can activates a total of 11 Mystic Enchants in a single specialization; 6 Rare, 3 Epic, 1 Legendary, and 1 Artifact.

Fill every active slot with an enchantment of the appropriate quality.

You can utilize the search bar in the Enchant Collection tab of the Mystic Enchants UI to filter by spells and abilities that you currently possess and find enchants that offer improvements to them. If your selection is limited, use a Mystic Altar to reforge Unimbued Mystic Scrolls to discover new ones and add them to your collection.

{T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\39_1:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

Activate a Mystic Enchant from Your Collection!


You can activate Mystic Enchants saved to your Enchant Collection at the Altar!

Open an Enchanting Altar and click select Enchant Collection tab.

Then select a Mystic Enchant from your Collection, apply it to an Active Enchant Slot, then click Save Changes.

{page} {T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\39_2:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

Activating Mystic Enchants Requires Mystic Orbs!


Collected enchants can be activated an unlimited number of times across all of your characters.

Each activation requires Mystic Orbs. If you run out of Orbs then gold will be consumed instead.

Mystic Orbs are found in almost all content. Call Board Daily Quests and completing Paths to Ascension is a great way to earn Orbs!

{page} {T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\39_3:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

Always Active! You Can Replace or Remove Enchants!


Activated Mystic Enchants Are Always Active! You can apply a new Mystic Enchant on top of an active one to overwrite it!

Right-click an active Mystic Enchant to remove it. Removed enchants will still be in your collection! This can be done without an Altar.
